content: Does your power bank have “CryoPulse technology” or a “Cyber Window”? If you disappointingly answered “no” to both, you might want to consider upgrading to Ugreen’s new MagFlow Pro Magnetic Power Bank. It’s available starting today for $149.99, which puts it on the really expensive end of power banks with only a 10,000mAh battery, but those fancy-sounding features are part of what Ugreen is claiming to be the world’s first liquid-cooling system on a power bank with wireless charging. Inside the MagFlow Pro is a micro-pump that’s used to circulate coolant and draw heat away from components including the power bank’s Qi2.2-compatible wireless charging coil. You can see the coolant flowing through a (cyber) window on the front of the power bank. That system works alongside copper foil and a design that keeps charging components separated to help reduce heat buildup to prolong the life of the power bank’s battery, the life of your phone, and to help maintain up to 25W of power delivery. It should result in leaving the MagFlow Pro cooler to the touch after a long charging session. [Image: The power bank’s lanyard doubles as a built-in USB-C charging cable, while an additional USB-C port can be used to charge a third device. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/ugreen2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] In addition to charging devices wirelessly, the power bank has a built-in USB-C cable lanyard and a USB-C port that can both charge devices at up to 45W, but that’s also the maximum output of the MagFlow Pro, so connecting multiple devices will reduce charging rates.

chineseContent: 您的移动电源是否具有“CryoPulse 技术”或“Cyber​​ Window”？如果您对两者的回答都令人失望，那么您可能需要考虑升级到 Ugreen 的新款 MagFlow Pro 磁性移动电源。它从今天开始上市，售价为 149.99 美元，这使其成为电池容量仅​​为 10,000mAh 的移动电源中非常昂贵的一端，但这些听起来很花哨的功能是 Ugreen 声称的世界上第一个具有无线充电功能的移动电源上的液体冷却系统的一部分。 MagFlow Pro 内部有一个微型泵，用于循环冷却剂并吸走移动电源兼容 Qi2.2 的无线充电线圈等组件的热量。您可以看到冷却液流过移动电源正面的（网络）窗口。该系统与铜箔配合使用，其设计使充电组件保持分离，有助于减少热量积聚，从而延长移动电源电池的寿命和手机的寿命，并有助于维持高达 25W 的电力输送。长时间充电后，MagFlow Pro 的触感会更凉爽。 [图片：移动电源的挂绳可兼作内置 USB-C 充电线，而额外的 USB-C 端口可用于为第三个设备充电。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/ugreen2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]除了为设备无线充电外，该移动电源还内置 USB-C 线缆挂绳和 USB-C 端口，可为设备提供高达 45W 的充电功率，但这也是 MagFlow Pro 的最大输出，因此连接多个设备会降低充电速率。
